mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_tag (id, name, color, organization_id, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{color}, #{organizationId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
INSERT INTO customer_tag_relation (id, customer_id, tag_id, create_time, create_user) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{tagId}, #{createTime}, #{createUser})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_tag_relation WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.color, t.organization_id, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_user, t.update_user FROM customer_tag t INNER JOIN customer_tag_relation r ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
